    1. Inonda LTD — Maintain · Repair · Transform.
    2. One contractor for everything — Nicosia and all of Cyprus.
    3. Written quotes, workmanship warranty — licensed technicians.
    4. 01/03 Maintenance: maintenance plans; scheduled checks and servicing; air conditioning: install, service, repair; roof waterproofing; stop leaks, damp and mould.
    5. 02/03 Repairs: plumbing; licensed plumbers; leaks, blockages, water heaters; electrical works; sockets, panels, lighting.
    6. 03/03 Home transformation: complete home renovation; new layouts; planning and itemised budget; kitchen renovation; modern living spaces; bathroom renovation; walk-in showers, full waterproofing; painting, plaster and gypsum; flooring and tiling; finishes that last; doors, windows and carpentry; made to measure; wardrobes and built-ins; outdoor works; pergolas, terraces and pool areas.
